need.kids: The dark, a test, being alone, something you cannot tell anyone.
need.teens: Exams, the future, a family that is not okay, the thing you have not said out loud.

need.kids: You can tell God you are sad. Lots of the Bible does exactly that.
need.teens: The Bible does not tell you to cheer up. A third of the Psalms are complaints.

need.kids: Nobody picked you. Nobody saved you a seat.
need.teens: New country, new school, a group chat you are not in.

need.kids: You can say sorry to God and he will forgive you. Every time.
need.teens: Not a technicality you exploit — a door that is genuinely still open.

need.kids: Being angry is not a sin. What you do next might be.
need.teens: The Bible is not squeamish about anger. It is careful about what anger is allowed to become.

need.kids: God knows what you need before you ask.
need.teens: Anxiety is not unbelief. These are verses to pray, not verses to be told.

title.kids: WHEN YOU WONDER IF GOD LOVES YOU

need.kids: He made you on purpose and he likes you.
need.teens: Not because you performed. Before you performed.

need.kids: The verses that say it most simply.
need.teens: His own claims, in his own words, before anyone else explained them.

title.teens: WHEN YOU DO NOT KNOW HOW TO PRAY

need.kids: Jesus taught his friends the words. You can use them too.
need.teens: Including what to do when you have no words at all.

title.teens: ABOUT WHO YOU SPEND TIME WITH

need.kids: How to be a good friend, and how to spot one.
need.teens: Loyalty, influence, and the cost of the wrong room.

need.kids: Parents, brothers, sisters — and what God asks of everyone in a house.
need.teens: Including families split across countries, which is most of ours.

need.kids: You are not too young for God to use you.
